version.changelog:
**0.11.0 introduces optional LLM review and dynamic engine selection.**

- Added support for LLM-based semantic analysis (`--use-llm`), configurable per scan.
- New `auto` engine mode automatically prefers external scanners, falling back to native if unavailable.
- Updated workflow and trust boundaries documentation: clarified scan behavior, LLM integration, and network features.
- Binary version bumped to v0.11.0 and checksum updated.
- Removed `skill-card.md` as part of documentation reorganization.

llm.summary: The skill artifacts are coherent maintenance and observability instructions with disclosed admin capabilities and explicit safety gates.

dimensions.detail: The files describe ClawHub, Axiom, Sentry, Convex, and documentation workflows; high-impact actions such as moderation, email, releases, migrations, and dashboard changes match those stated purposes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Sensitive workflows require explicit targets, reasons, dry-runs, confirmation, signoff, or verification before writes; no artifact-backed prompt override, deception, or hidden unrelated behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Several helper scripts use local CLIs, API tokens, and setup commands, including chmod and config checks, but these are disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skills can access observability, Slack, Sentry, GitHub, Convex, and ClawHub admin surfaces when configured; this is broad but appropriate for SRE and registry-maintenance use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The Axiom SRE skill creates local memory under ~/.config/axiom-sre and can optionally sync org memory through git; this persistence is documented and not hidden.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use these operational workflows and trust the configured API tokens, admin CLI access, and optional memory sync repositories. Review the confirmation gates before using moderation, release, migration, email, or org-memory sharing commands.
